people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
translations.bsb: Then the king of Assyria invaded the whole land, marched up to Samaria, and besieged it for three years.
